subject: Re: Kickoff: microscope focus-quality QC — decisions to close the window
body:
Team,

Decisions so we close cleanly by Jul 27:

1) We go with Halima's option (a) — tiled montage assembly with downsampled previews. Partner 2's bench-side story is the differentiator; we're not giving it up to save two weeks.
2) Consequence: the leaderboard service ships as v0.9 — Jorge's ingestion and per-dataset leaderboards are done, corp-directory auth done, but public submissions open in August instead of mid-July. Comms to partners go out this week.
3) Katya's consolidated master script is now the only supported entry point; the two legacy macros are frozen.

Nadia — we'd like a Launch Review Board slot the week of Jul 20 for the partner-facing QC gate; sign-off before any external demo per process.

Thanks all,
Lucia
